layers.authority: CONANP (Comision Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas), Reserva de la Biosfera Calakmul
layers.process: Entry fee of MXN 225 per person per day (about A$17.01; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040; Banco de Mexico FIX, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962)). Exempt: older adults, pensioners and retirees, people with disability and children under 12 (credential shown on entry). 75% off for students and teachers with a credential; 50% off for Mexican nationals and foreign residents who show an official document. Open 6:00 to 15:00 daily. Trails must be entered with a certified guide. Tourism vehicles must be authorised by CONANP, and double-axle (dual-wheel) vehicles aren't allowed in. The page still carries COVID-19 capacity rules; confirm current rules with the reserve office.

sources.authority: CONANP

zone-requirements.notes: Federal park fees and rules as published on CONANP's Descubre ANP page, which says amounts follow the Ley Federal de Derechos and can change. Other parks in this state aren't checked.

laws.rule: Calakmul Biosphere Reserve: CONANP's visitor rules say vehicles with dual wheels aren't allowed in, tourism vehicles must be authorised by CONANP, guides carry valid certification, and trails must be entered with a certified guide. Breaches can be sanctioned under CONANP authorisations and the federal ecological balance law (LGEEPA).

items.text: The Ley para la Venta Ordenada y Consumo Responsable de Bebidas Alcohólicas del Estado de Campeche (congress juridical compendium, last reform Decree 188, Periódico Oficial 29 December 2025) forbids the sale and consumption of alcoholic drinks by anyone under 18, and by people who are clearly drunk, armed people, and soldiers or police who are in uniform or on duty (art. 10 I). Minors must not be allowed into cantinas, beer halls, cabarets, nightclubs, discos and bars; a visible sign is required, and official identification must be asked for to confirm age (art. 10 II).

Article 10 III forbids commercialising, selling, distributing, supplying or serving alcoholic drinks in public areas, parks and streets, except in licensed tourist-polygon street areas allowed by this law, and except for a limited, temporary municipal permit during festivities that allow it. In venues licensed only for sale in a closed container, consumption inside and sale in an open container are also banned (art. 10 IV).

Article 15 sets statewide hours, which must appear on the licence. Examples: nightclubs, cabarets and discos Sunday to Thursday 21:00 to 02:00 and Friday and Saturday 22:00 to 04:00; cantinas, cocktail bars, snack bars and beer halls 12:00 to 20:00 every day; supermarkets, depots and liquor stores 09:00 to 21:00; mini-markets, grocery shops and similar 10:00 to 22:00 (a 'Minisúper Local' 09:00 to 24:00); restaurants Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 03:00 and Sunday 10:00 to 01:00; bars 13:00 to 02:00 every day; hotels and motels Monday to Saturday 09:00 to 02:00 and Sunday 09:00 to 24:00; tourist polygons 12:00 to 02:00 every day. The Junta Reguladora may shorten hours and days of operation by general rules published in the Periódico Oficial. Patrons may not stay after closing time. Licensed venues not listed in article 15 operate Monday to Saturday 11:00 to 19:00 (art. 16).

psychoactive-substances.notes: This is state law on licensed sale and consumption. The official congress compendium PDF was read; its header marks it as a consultation text without legal validity. Last reform recorded on the file: Decree 188, Periódico Oficial 29 December 2025 (the cover also says last reform 18 December 2025).
